Each project is a live checklist — the progress bar + n/n shipped track completion; the interconnects band shows what each project feeds (→) and is fed by (←). This is the backlog that seeds a per-project .prism plan + stories once reviewed.

Codexes - the one-page architecture doc for each node. Live cards open the published artifact (pop-out); the coverage strip shows which nodes have a codex. Kept in sync by the codex publish loop.

Meridian — the attention/ADHD substrate. Toggle between the live Morning Briefing (channels refreshed by griot-meridian-reflect) and the Interface Mirror (day-surface planning). Each shows its last update + sync state; both stay in sync via griot-meridian-reflect + dgs-plan-update.

Potluck — the OSS decision layer. For each tool, set how deep you're taking it — 🏗️ Scaffold (the app/surface is built on it) · 🧩 Component (a library dropped into a surface) · 💡 Pattern (approach reimplemented) — and your decision: 🔥 Adopt · 🧪 Trial · 🕒 Defer · ⛔ Pass. Toggle by stage ↔ by decision to regroup. The Adopt picks are each project's SOTA build recipe. Changes persist while this stays open.

Potluck — the studio's OSS shelf, folded into the plan (canonical array = POT_T). Curated tools with the decision cockpit, the impact matrix, and the by-video firehose. Group by stage/decision/project · filter by lane/category/app. Changes persist while open.

The Meridian lens: work that reads as stale, parked, folded-away, or quietly lost across months of building. No shame surface — just what needs a decision to close the loop or consciously let go.
